name: BananaCrystal
description: Agent payment MCP for live FX rates, currency swaps and payments in 140+ local currencies. Agents get a wallet and can estimate swap fees, swap between local-currency stablecoins, send stablecoin payments to a wallet or BananaCrystal username, add money and cash out to a bank account after an ID check, and check balances, limits and history. Payments settle on Hedera. Transfers, swaps and withdrawals ask for an email code by default.
author: BananaCrystal
